goal: PASS known PLUS / (PASS known PLUS + PASS known MINUS) >=0.80
teacher: Frozen Entry to frozen EXIT/EOD after original costs; PLUS=1, MINUS=0, ZERO/UNKNOWN excluded from sign training/scoring and retained separately

candidate_design.input_difference_from_old: Exact first-intent P1 matrix (148 numeric, 15 categorical), with fixed current State9 numeric/qualitative and causal history; old Sign had only P0 plus compact fill-boundary State. Optional prior structure distances/pivots are intent-only.
candidate_design.P1_score: Reuse only generated predictions/threshold/margin with train index and maturity provenance; no label/backscore substitution.
candidate_design.other_Winner_scores: Not enabled unless full FIT/CAL/TEST producer dependency and timing/coverage are bound.

preprocessing: FIT-only numeric median plus missing flags; FIT-only categorical one-hot with explicit missing/unknown; FIT-only scaling for Logistic; schema and transform hashes required before fitting

splits.FIT: past sessions except last 5, matured before CAL start
splits.CAL: last 5 past sessions, matured before TEST start; same FIT model

model_fit_ceiling.technical_retries: Do not set until serialization/import and equivalence checks complete; no automatic model retry loops.

threshold_selection.method: linear CAL-score quantiles; CAL labels only
threshold_selection.selection: Among qualified thresholds maximize PLUS retention; tie break fewer passed MINUS, then fixed quantile order. No threshold chosen on TEST.

provisional_confirmation_gate.strict_zero_unknown: report separate counts and all-PASS unknown fraction; no coercion
report: PLUS/MINUS x predicted_PLUS/predicted_MINUS at fixed score0.5
PLUS/MINUS x PASS/REJECT at locked tau
PLUS retention MINUS removal passed MINUS rate
ZERO UNKNOWN unsupported rows kept separate

before_freezing: Verify originals and private hashes without opening protected partitions
Freeze feature schema and exact intent identity/provenance
Confirm label maturity and FIT/preprocessor/score producer dependencies
Check support feasibility with metadata before labels
Resolve exact estimator defaults/software versions/selection tie rules

failure_policy: Report failure and terminate this finite configuration; do not append candidates/seeds/thresholds to fit reused TEST. Specify missing information before proposing next finite Work.
